name: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd.
summary: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells watches and related components worldwide. It operates through three segments: Watch Business, Machine Tool Business, and Device Business. The company offers equipment and wall clocks; machine tools; and devices and components, such as compact automotive components, crystal units, miniaturized motors, LEDs for lighting, printers, and healthcare equipment under brands such as Citizen, Bulova, and Frederique Constant. It also provides technical services. Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. was founded in 1918 and is headquartered in Nishitokyo, Japan.
